tasks.name: Obstacle Corridor Detour Survey 6
tasks.content: Cover the corridor from (145.2, 188.2) to (885.2, 537.2) with Span Four flying at 24.4 meters. A blocked structure (Cable Tower B) sits between the two ends: stay at least 41 meters away from it and take two photographs, one at each end, then hover at the far end when finished. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
